title: #80: npm lockfile changes in the Review summary
body:
Closes #80 (first slice of #79).

A PR that changes a `package-lock.json` (lockfile versions 2 and 3) now gets a dependency section in its Review summary. Each lockfile lists every package added, removed, moved from one version to another, or resolved from a new source or integrity at the same version.

- **New Dependency check step** (`src/dependencies.ts`). It runs after scope selection and compares each changed lockfile at the PR diff's base side (the merge-base) and at head. A package installed in several places counts once per lockfile. Workspace folders and links don't count; bundled packages and `npm:` aliases (under their real name) do.
- **Unsupported lockfiles** (e.g. `yarn.lock`) are named as not checked.
- **Excluded lockfiles** (per-repo `exclude` globs or `.gitattributes` marks) are left out and not mentioned.
- **Unreadable lockfiles** are named and block approval with their own unwaivable line.
- **Lockfiles stay out of line review** and the token budget. The "no reviewers ran" blocker is unchanged.
- **The summary list** goes through `pathList`: capped at 50 packages per lockfile and 20 lockfiles, and sanitized.
- **Posting:** a run now posts whenever there is a dependency section, so every push to a PR that changes a lockfile gets a summary.
- **Run record and Dashboard:** the Run record keeps the result (`dependency_checks` table, pruned with the run), and the Dashboard's run page shows it.
- **Progress and supersession:** progress is logged as `dependencies checked`, and a superseded run stops right after the step.
- **Docs:** REQUIREMENTS §8, §9.1, §9.3 and §12 are updated. `CONTEXT.md` and ADR 0002 are landed from `worktree-dependency-check-grilling`.

Tests: `test/dependencies.test.ts` has unit cases for the pure comparison plus harness cases, including the 911day#256 shape and main moving the lockfile after branching. A Dashboard case is in `test/dashboard.test.ts`. `npm test` passes: 207 tests.

expected.defect: A PR author can make the review worker spend quadratic time and memory, potentially terminating the process.

acceptableExtras.title: Package text in the review summary is uncapped
The dashboard renders every package change
Every changed lockfile is read and compared
